features.text: Be Home Free With LG Styler
The LG Styler reduces bacteria and fungi by over 99% for a happier day at home.
Refreshing Partner For Your Weekly Wash

Upgrade your laundry room with the LG Styler. Refresh clothes between cleanings and reduce wrinkles and odors with the gentle power of steam. It even helps sanitize and removes allergens. Plus, it comes in white or espresso to complement the design of your ultimate laundry room.

After independent testing in accredited laboratories, LG Styler has been certified by the Asthma and Allergy Foundation of America. That means it is scientifically proven to be better suited for the 1 out of 5 Americans with asthma and allergies.
Vanquish Odors with the Gentle Power of Steam
The LG Styler's TrueSteam® technology reduces the odors that cling to fabrics, knitwear and even delicates. You'll effortlessly make odors from smoke, sweat and food a thing of the past.
The Sanitary cycle powered by TrueSteam® helps reduce allergens in clothes, bedding, sportswear—even your children's plush toys. LG Styler can help sanitize the fabrics in your home easily.
LG Styler's low temperature drying system dries clothing and delicates you normally dry on a rack much faster than air drying.
The LG Styler includes a special compartment in the door that helps restore the crease while reducing wrinkles at the knee, waist and everywhere else your pants can wrinkle.

Discover the new LG Styler now with SmartThinQ®: get alerts when cycles finish, start cycles remotely, download specialized care cycles and monitor energy usage. It even works with the Google Assistant, so you can refresh with simple voice commands.
